description: This file contains unit tests for the Testlink API's XML-RPC server implementation, verifying various API endpoints, error handling, and input validation using PHPUnit framework.

classes.name: TestlinkXMLRPCServerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the XML-RPC API endpoints of the TestLink server, including test reporting, project retrieval, test case management, and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the IXR client and sets debug mode before each test.

methods.name: suite
methods.description: Creates and returns a test suite with specific test cases added.

methods.name: testSayHello
methods.description: Tests the 'tl.sayHello' method for expected greeting response.

methods.name: testReportTCResultWithInvalidDevKey
methods.description: Verifies error response when reporting test case result with an invalid developer key.

methods.name: testReportTCResultWithInsufficientRights
methods.description: Checks error response when reporting test case result with a user lacking rights.

methods.name: testReportTCResultWithoutDevKey
methods.description: Validates error response when no developer key is provided.

methods.name: testReportTCResultWithEmptyDevKey
methods.description: Validates error response when an empty developer key is used.

methods.name: testReportTCResultWithoutTCID
methods.description: Checks for proper error when the test case ID parameter is missing.

methods.name: testReportTCResultWithInvalidTCID
methods.description: Tests error response when providing an invalid (negative) test case ID.

methods.name: testReportTCResultWithoutNonIntTCID
methods.description: Tests validation errors when the test case ID is non-integer.

methods.name: testReportTCResultWithoutTPID
methods.description: Checks error handling when test plan ID is missing.

methods.name: testReportTCResultRequestWithoutStatus
methods.description: Verifies error response when 'status' parameter is omitted.

methods.name: testReportTCResultRequestWithInvalidStatus
methods.description: Checks for invalid 'status' parameter value error.

methods.name: testReportTCResultRequestWithBlockedStatus
methods.description: Tests reporting a test result with 'blocked' status.

methods.name: testReportTCResultRequestWithPassedStatus
methods.description: Tests reporting a test result with 'passed' status.

methods.name: testReportTCResultRequestWithFailedStatus
methods.description: Tests reporting a test result with 'failed' status.

methods.name: testReportTCResultWithNoParams
methods.description: Checks response when no parameters are provided to report test result.

methods.name: testReportTCResultValidRequest
methods.description: Tests successful report of a test case result.

methods.name: testGetLastTestResult
methods.description: Tests fetching the last test result after reporting a known status.

methods.name: testReportTCResultRequestWithValidBuildID
methods.description: Tests reporting a test case result with a specific build ID.

methods.name: testReportTCResultNotGuessingBuildID
methods.description: Tests reporting test result with guessing build ID disabled.

methods.name: testReportTCResultWithTimestamp
methods.description: Placeholder for unimplemented test related to timestamp reporting.

methods.name: testReportTCResultWithNotes
methods.description: Tests reporting a test result with additional notes.

methods.name: testCreateBuildWithInsufficientRights
methods.description: Tests creation of a build with user lacking rights, expecting an error.

methods.name: testCreateBuildWithoutNotes
methods.description: Tests creation of a build without optional notes.

methods.name: testCreateBuildWithNotes
methods.description: Tests creation of a build with notes.

methods.name: testCreateBuildWithInvalidTPID
methods.description: Verifies error response with invalid test plan ID.

methods.name: testValidDevKeyWorks
methods.description: Confirms valid devKey allows successful test report and does not trigger errors.

methods.name: testGetProjects
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of projects with valid developer key.

methods.name: testGetProjectsWithInsufficientRights
methods.description: Checks error when retrieving projects with user lacking rights.

methods.name: testGetProjectTestPlans
methods.description: Tests retrieving test plans for a specific project.

methods.name: testGetTestSuitesForTestPlan
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving test suites for a test plan.

methods.name: testGetTestSuitesForTestPlanWithoutTestPlanID
methods.description: Placeholder for test case without test plan ID.

methods.name: testGetTestCasesForTestSuite
methods.description: Tests retrieving test cases within a specific test suite.

methods.name: testGetTestCasesForTestSuiteWithInsufficientRights
methods.description: Checks error when retrieving test cases with insufficient rights.

methods.name: testGetTestCasesForTestSuiteDeepFalse
methods.description: Tests retrieving test cases with 'deep' parameter false.

methods.name: testGetTestCasesForTestSuiteWithoutSuiteID
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving test cases without suite ID.

methods.name: testGetTestCaseIDByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of test case ID by name, expecting specific ID and details.

methods.name: testGetTestCaseIDByNameWithInsufficientRights
methods.description: Tests retrieval with user lacking rights, expecting error.

methods.name: testGetTestCaseIDByNameWithInvalidName
methods.description: Tests retrieval when specified test case name does not exist.

methods.name: testRepeat
methods.description: Tests 'tl.repeat' method echo functionality.

methods.name: testAbout
methods.description: Tests 'tl.about' method response.

methods.name: testNonExistantMethod
methods.description: Verifies behavior when calling a non-existing method.
